note: Pike County GA parcels are published only through the qPublic (Schneider) viewer, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) and exposes no public ArcGIS REST service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and county pages found no Pike County GA parcel FeatureServer/MapServer. The pikepa.org service found is Pike County, Pennsylvania. Remaining parcel sources are commercial paid downloads (Dynamo Spatial, Regrid, Rockford Map, Equator Studios).
